description: This file contains Python code defining character ranges, regular expressions, and a class 'InfosetFilter' for processing and coercing XML/HTML character data, including handling of Unicode characters and warnings.

classes.name: InfosetFilter
classes.description: A class for filtering and coercing XML/HTML data, handling character replacements, and managing warnings related to XML character constraints.

methods.name: coerceAttribute
methods.description: Coerces attribute names, handling xmlns attributes and applying name transformations.

methods.name: coerceElement
methods.description: Coerces element names, applying name transformations.

methods.name: coerceComment
methods.description: Adjusts comment data to prevent adjacent dashes if configured.

methods.name: coerceCharacters
methods.description: Replaces form feed characters and filters non-XML characters.

methods.name: coercePubid
methods.description: Coerces public identifiers, replacing invalid characters and handling single quotes.

methods.name: toXmlName
methods.description: Converts a name to a valid XML name, replacing invalid starting characters and internal characters.

methods.name: getReplacementCharacter
methods.description: Returns a replacement string for a given character, using cache or escaping.

methods.name: fromXmlName
methods.description: Converts an XML name back to its original form by unescaping.

methods.name: escapeChar
methods.description: Creates a Unicode escape string for a character and caches it.

methods.name: unescapeChar
methods.description: Converts a Unicode escape string back to a character.
